_comment: Ground truth for the scrim scoreboard read. Captured 2026-09-06 on Colosseo,
ten bots plus the operator, PAUSED AT ONE POINT and screenshotted eight times
from different camera angles. The board content is therefore IDENTICAL in every
frame and the background is the only variable - which is the experiment section
8.4 of the design says had never been run, and without which no colour or
preprocessing number can be attributed to anything.
Every frame is 2557x1437 and shows the shipped layout: white named rows, slot
ordering, orange chrome, blue/deep-red TEAM headers.
'x' is the sixth column, whose meaning is role-dependent (ACC/BLK/HEAL). It is
stored as the literal string because that is what OCR has to reproduce - the
trailing % on a DPS row is part of the read, not a formatting detail.

box._comment: Fraction of frame width/height. Operator-drawn in the real tool; fixed here so preprocessing is the only variable.
